info.name: Get aggregated utilization information for all machines under a customer group

params.name: access_token
params.description: Access token

params.name: customer_group_uuid
params.description: Customer group UUID

params.name: page
params.description: Page number

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page

params.name: time_zone
params.description: Time zone string. Default to user time zone if not specified.

params.name: start_work_hour
params.description: Start work hour, integer 0~23. Default work hours to all 24 hours if not specified.

params.name: end_work_hour
params.description: End work hour, integer 0~23. Default work hours to all 24 hours if not specified.

params.name: work_days[]
params.description: Work day (1~7 representing mon~sun). Enter single parameter text value in this form (e.g. 3). Default to all 7 days if not specified. For help on multiple values, contact Customer Support.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date of the requested date range, default date range is last 30 days (e.g. 2022-05-31). If start_date is specified, end_date will become required.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date of the requested date range, default date range is last 30 days (e.g. 2022-06-07). If end_date is specified, start_date will become required.

params.name: location_tags[]
params.description: Location tag filter. Enter single parameter text value in this form (e.g. Lab 24).  For help on multiple values, contact Customer Support.

params.name: equipment_category_tags[]
params.description: Equipment category tag filter. Enter single parameter text value in this form (e.g. Centrifuge).  For help on multiple values, contact Customer Support.

params.name: machine_uuids[]
params.description: Machine UUID filter.  Enter single parameter text value in this form (e.g. 454d60e3-05c3-4356-872e-fbd480fe91fa).  For help on multiple values, contact Customer Support.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: One of equipment_name, most_used [most_used is default]

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: asc or desc [asc is default]

items.docs: Get aggregated utilization information for all machines under a customer group
